items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: The person 'Your Daddy' refers to the interviewee's father. The transcript describes a familial relationship (parent/child), which is not included in the controlled vocabulary for professional or social music relationships.

ctx.x: He remarried later, as we got older. When my mother died, my youngest sister, Rose, who is now living in San Francisco, was about 2 years old -- very young. I had an older sister, Jules, that's still living in New Orleans now. And between her and my Dad and my older brother Henry, who is dead, he died when he was 49 here in Los Angeles... Between the older kids and my Dad, they took care of us, the young ones. But we kids had all the chores to do. I guess I was about... When my mother died I was, I don't know,…
Your Daddy fixed shoes for the neighborhood people?
Oh yes. My Dad... Baton Rouge was a small town at that time.
